name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. It guarantees visibility on monochrome and low-vision displays, meeting WCAG AAA. The trade-off is slightly larger touch targets, but EXCAVA’s buttons are already oversized for mobile, so it’s negligible.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast fails on high-DPI mobile screens where 4px collapses to 2px. A 3px ring at 5.5:1 contrast still fails users who need 6:1 for low vision. The real risk is excluding users on high-DPI devices. Settle it by testing both rings on a 4K mobile screen under 150% zoom.
